description: This source file handles Rocket UI events and commands within the Unvanquished game engine, including functions for opening, closing, navigating, and manipulating UI documents, as well as server initialization and data source management.

classes.name: eventCmd_t
classes.description: Structure representing a command and its associated execution function for processing UI events.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_EventOpen
methods.description: Loads a Rocket document based on the provided argument.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_EventClose
methods.description: Closes a Rocket document identified by the argument.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_InitServers
methods.description: Resets server pings and status, and sends commands to initialize server lists based on source.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_BuildDS
methods.description: Builds a data source with specified parameters.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_SortDS
methods.description: Sorts a data source based on provided parameters.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_SetDS
methods.description: Sets the index of a data source.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_FilterDS
methods.description: Filters a data source based on attribute value.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_SetChatCommand
methods.description: Sets chat command attribute based on current say type.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_EventExecForm
methods.description: Processes form submission, constructs command string, and executes it.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_EventPlay
methods.description: Plays a random background sound from provided arguments.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_ResetPings
methods.description: Resets and updates server pings for a given source.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_ProcessEvents
methods.description: Main function to process queued Rocket UI events and execute corresponding commands.
